$description: Every place decoration may live. A theme fills a slot in theme.json `slots` with a scene generator ({"scene": "hall" | "room"}, scene slots only), an image of its own ("art/<file>"), or {"image": "art/<file>", "rendering": "pixel" | "smooth", "fit": "cover" | "contain" | "stretch" | "slice", "slice": <px, with fit slice>} (default pixel and cover; slice, a 9-slice frame, on surfaces only). An image fill may also take "anchor": "top" | "center" | "bottom" (the part kept whole when a tall picture is cropped; default center), "rooms": {room: "art/<file>"} or {room: {"dark" | "light": "art/<file>"}} (another picture in those rooms, per scheme if needed), and "schemes": {"dark" | "light": "art/<file>"} (another picture in that scheme; a room's own picture wins). Every slot takes an image; all are optional: every layout is right with every slot empty. Sizes are the box on screen: draw at that size (or a whole multiple, for pixel art). `min` is the smallest picture that isn't upscaled (smooth art smaller than it blurs).

status.backdrop.size: 320 × 16 strip, the status bar's full width
status.backdrop.purpose: a strip behind the house's name and the bar (its strength: part.status.art-opacity)

home.hero.backdrop.purpose: the house at the real time of day, on Home

auth.crest.purpose: the house's emblem on the sign-in page

watch.tv.bezel.purpose: the frame around the TV picture

space.room.scene.purpose: the person's room in My Space

page.backdrop.size: the whole window, cover (1600 × 900 is plenty)
page.backdrop.purpose: a picture behind every page, under the part.page.scrim

header.banner.size: the page header's width × 160, fades into the page
header.banner.purpose: a banner behind each room's title (with parts.header: banner)

state.empty.purpose: the picture of an empty state (instead of Nox)

rail.art.size: the rail's width × up to 240, at its foot
rail.art.purpose: a decoration at the bottom of the rail (wide screens)

deck.surface.size: the music player on Listen, up to 480 × 560 (a 9-slice frame fits all)
deck.surface.purpose: the music player's own picture or skin
